ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Mercury and Venus

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
Until {H:1823245298000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:7}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Switch off your phone an hour before bed.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
Until {H:1823245298000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up your career and your goals.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:7}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on relationships and partnerships. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Introduce two people who could help each other.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
Until {H:1823245298000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:7}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on routine, daily work and health. A new beginning may be born from here.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Think of one small step that brings you closer to your big dream.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
Until {H:1823245298000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:7}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. This is where your strength lies today.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Read something that inspires you and keep one sentence.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
Until {H:1823245298000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:7}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on home and family. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
Until {H:1823245298000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

Mercury and Venus are together in {S:7}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
Until {H:1823245298000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:7}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on your money and what you value. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
Until {H:1823245298000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up home and family.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:7}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on your image and your personal energy. It is a good day to start something in this area.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
Until {H:1823245298000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:7}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on rest and your inner life. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
Until {H:1823245298000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up your money and what you value.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:7}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on friends and plans for the future. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
Until {H:1823245298000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:7}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on your career and your goals. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
Until {H:1823245298000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
Mercury and Venus are together in {S:7}: ideas and words, affection and harmony, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.
